zh: 我登录不了，系统说我密码错了。
en: I can't {log in|sign in|log on|get in}. It says my password is wrong.

zh: 故障之后我们把这次发布回滚了。
en: We {rolled back|reverted|backed out} the release after the outage.

zh: 升级之前一定要备份你的文件。
en: Make sure you {back up|save|copy} your files before the upgrade.

zh: 昨晚服务器自己关机了。
en: The server {shut down|switched off|turned off|powered off} by itself last night.

zh: 你把充电器插上了吗？
en: Have you {plugged in|connected} the charger?

zh: IT部门今天下午在给我配置新电脑。
en: IT is {setting up|configuring} my new laptop this afternoon.

zh: 我昨天注册了免费试用。
en: I {signed up for|registered for} the free trial yesterday.

zh: 显示器开不了机。
en: The monitor won't {turn on|switch on|come on|power on|start|work}.

zh: 我终于弄明白构建为什么失败了。
en: I finally {figured out|worked out|found out} why the build was failing.

zh: 今天早上网站宕机了两个小时。
en: The website {went down|was down} for two hours this morning.

zh: 往下滚动，你就能看到下载按钮。
en: If you {scroll down}, you'll see the download button.

zh: 你能帮我把议程打印出来吗？
en: Could you {print out|print off|print} the agenda for me?

zh: 她连续三次输错了密码。
en: She {typed in|entered|put in|keyed in|typed} the wrong password three times.

zh: 你可以在设置里选择退订营销邮件。
en: You can {opt out of|unsubscribe from|turn off|switch off|stop|disable|block} marketing emails in your settings.

zh: 我们会在六月前逐步淘汰旧系统。
en: We're {phasing out|retiring|replacing|removing|decommissioning} the old system by June.

zh: 他已经把笔记本电脑连到大屏幕上了。
en: He's {hooked up|connected} the laptop to the big screen.

zh: 视频通话的时候我的电脑老是卡死。
en: My laptop keeps {freezing up|freezing|crashing|locking up|hanging} during video calls.

zh: 测试的时候我们遇到了几个程序错误。
en: We {ran into|came across|hit|found} a few bugs during testing.

zh: 我每次打开这个应用都会弹出一条错误信息。
en: An error message {pops up|comes up|appears|shows up} every time I open the app.

zh: 办公室的打印机老是出毛病。
en: The office printer keeps {playing up|acting up|jamming|breaking|breaking down|failing}.
